result.brief: 提出可验证的“伪影即评分标准”视频奖励模型，先识别生成伪影形成结构化中间表征再打分，并用多奖励强化学习联合优化伪影预测与质量偏好，用于视频扩散模型优化与评测。
result.reason: Video reward model with structured artifact rubric intermediate representation for video generation RL optimization and evaluation; directly serves video generation training and reward signals.
